instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required icon libraries: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react react-icons @heroicons/react iconoir-react @radix-ui/react-icons`.
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' are imported in `index.css` via the Google Fonts link provided.
Use the existing Shadcn components in `src/components/ui/` for all interactive elements (forms, dialogs, cards).
For the 'Admin Dashboard', switch to a dense layout protocol: reduced padding, smaller fonts (13px/14px), and high data density.
The 'Quote Form' must be printable. Ensure a specific print stylesheet or media query (`@media print`) hides navigation/footer and formats the quote cleanly on A4 paper.
Implement the 'Sticky CTA' for mobile on the homepage: A fixed bottom bar with 'Appeler 514-386-1743' in Gold background with Blue text.
CRITICAL: Do not use default shades of blue. Always use the brand primary `#1a365d`.
For the Tech division pages, consider a 'Dark Mode' switch or default to a dark theme to differentiate it from the renovation services.
Use `lucide-react` icons (already present) as the primary icon set, but use `phosphor-icons` for feature highlights if needed.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
